definitions.gloss: the tiles held in one's hand; one's hand
definitions.explanation: In mahjong, the set of tiles a player holds and manages during play, kept hidden from opponents until they are used or discarded.

examples.japanese: {手|て}{牌|はい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整理|せいり}する→整理する：21729_seirisuru⟧。
{手|て}{牌|はい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}せない→見せる：01988_miseru⟧。
examples.english: Don't show your hand to your opponents.

examples.japanese: ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧{手|て}{牌|はい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧そろった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{勝負|しょうぶ}→勝負：01437_shoubu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ことにした。
examples.english: My hand came together nicely, so I decided to go for the win.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧ (hand) + {牌|はい} (tile). In mahjong, the tiles a player holds and reorganizes as the game goes on. Also read しゅはい.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手|て}{牌|はい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整理|せいり}する→整理する：21729_seirisuru⟧: to arrange one's hand
- {手|て}{牌|はい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to discard from one's hand

Mainly a mahjong term.
